features.name: load_cgo
features.summary: Load a Compiled Graphics Object (a flat list of floats built from cgo.py constants) as a named object.

features.name: color
features.summary: Changes the colour of objects or atoms; the primary colour assigner accepting names, indices, hex, specials, or ramp objects.

features.name: color_deep
features.summary: Unsets all object- and atom-level colour settings then applies a colour, clearing every per-rep override.

features.name: colour
features.summary: British-spelling alias of color; changes the color of objects or atoms.

features.name: del_colorection
features.summary: Deletes a stored colorection (named color-by-selection snapshot) entry.

features.name: desaturate
features.summary: Desaturates the colours in a selection by blending each atom's colour toward grey.

features.name: get_color_indices
features.summary: Returns the list of (name, index) pairs for the color table.

features.name: get_colorection
features.summary: Snapshots the current colour of everything under a key, for scene colour capture.

features.name: get_object_color_index
features.summary: Returns the integer color index assigned to a named object.

features.name: ramp_new
features.summary: Create a color-ramp gadget object that colors atoms by map potential or by proximity to a molecular object.
features.signature: ramp_new(name, map_name, range=[-1.0, 0.0, 1.0], color=['red', [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], 'blue'], state=1, selection='', beyond=2.0, within=6.0, sigma=2.0, zero=1, quiet=1)

features.name: ramp_update
features.summary: Update the value range and/or colors of an existing color-ramp object.

features.name: recolor
features.summary: Forces reapplication of colours to already-built geometry; required after set_color redefines a colour in use.

features.name: recolour
features.summary: British-spelling alias of recolor - reapplies colors to existing objects.

features.name: set_color
features.summary: Defines a new colour (or redefines an existing one) from RGB components, extending the colour-index table.

features.name: set_colorection
features.summary: Restores a saved set of color assignments (a colorection) from a dict under a given key.

features.name: set_colour
features.summary: British-spelling alias of set_color; defines a named color from RGB components.

features.name: set_object_color
features.summary: Sets an object's whole-object color attribute (distinct from per-atom colors).

features.name: space
features.summary: Selects the working color palette/space (rgb, cmyk, or pymol) to keep on-screen colors print/video-safe.

features.name: spectrum
features.summary: Colors atoms with a spectrum of colors based on an atomic property such as count, B-factor, occupancy, or partial charge.
features.signature: spectrum(expression='count', palette='rainbow', selection='(all)', minimum=None, maximum=None, byres=0, quiet=1, interpolation='rgb')

features.name: spectrumany
features.summary: Pure-Python spectrum fallback accepting arbitrary colour lists and rgb/hls/hsv interpolation; drives spectrum for non-alphabetic expressions.
features.signature: spectrumany(expression, colors, selection='(all)', minimum=None, maximum=None, quiet=1, interpolation='rgb')

features.name: abort
features.summary: Abruptly terminates execution of the running PyMOL command script.

features.name: api
features.summary: Prints the fully-qualified module.function name that implements a given PyMOL command.

features.name: async_
features.summary: Runs a function on a background thread while showing a "please wait..." message.

features.name: block_flush
features.summary: Internal API-lock helper that suppresses command-queue flushing.

features.name: cd
features.summary: Changes the current working directory.

features.name: cls
features.summary: Clears the text output buffer.

features.name: commands
features.summary: Prints a categorised cheat-sheet of PyMOL's most common commands.

features.name: decline
features.summary: Internal method that declines a session-file security prompt.

features.name: exp_path
features.summary: Expands user (~) and environment-variable references in a filesystem path.

features.name: extendaa
features.summary: API-only decorator that registers a Python function as a PyMOL command with argument auto-completion.

features.name: fb_action
features.summary: Internal enum container holding the numeric codes for feedback actions (set/enable/disable) used by the feedback command.

features.name: fb_mask
features.summary: Internal enum container holding the numeric codes for feedback output categories (masks) used by the feedback command.

features.name: fb_module
features.summary: Internal enum container holding the numeric codes for PyMOL feedback modules (subsystems) used by the feedback command.

features.name: feedback
features.summary: Adjusts how much diagnostic output PyMOL prints, per subsystem module and per output category.

features.name: get_progress
features.summary: Return the fractional progress of a long-running task, optionally resetting the tracker.

features.name: help
features.summary: Prints the online help (docstring) for a given command or topic.

features.name: interrupt
features.summary: Signals the engine to interrupt a running operation (asynchronous, no locking).

features.name: LockCM
features.summary: Context manager that acquires and releases PyMOL's API lock around a block of code.

features.name: log
features.summary: Write a command (or its Python equivalent) to the currently open log file.

features.name: log_close
features.summary: Close the currently open log file and turn logging off.

features.name: log_open
features.summary: Open a log file for writing, selecting .pml or .py logging mode from the filename extension.

features.name: ls
features.summary: Lists the contents of the current working directory, optionally filtered by a glob pattern.

features.name: pwd
features.summary: Print the current working directory to the log.

features.name: python_help
features.summary: Help stub explaining how Python keywords and blocks work inside the PyMOL command language.

features.name: reinitialize
features.summary: Reset PyMOL by deleting all objects and restoring default settings (with selectable scope).

features.name: resume
features.summary: Replays an existing log file and reopens it in append mode for continued recording.

features.name: SafeEvalNS
features.summary: Namespace object that makes eval() resolve any bare name to its own string.

features.name: Shortcut
features.summary: Abbreviation/auto-completion engine that resolves unambiguous prefixes of a keyword set.

features.name: show_help
features.summary: Internal helper that prints help text for a command keyword (backs the 'help' command).

features.name: spawn
features.summary: Launches a Python script in a new background thread that runs concurrently with the interpreter.

features.name: sync
features.summary: API-only barrier that blocks until all queued commands have finished executing, with a timeout.

features.name: unblock_flush
features.summary: Internal helper that re-enables flushing of the command queue when the API lock is released.

features.name: add_bond
features.summary: API-only function that adds a bond between two atoms specified by 1-based atom index.

features.name: alphatoall
features.summary: Copies a per-residue property from each residue's CA atom out to all atoms in that residue.

features.name: alter_list
features.summary: Unsupported bulk variant of alter that applies a list of per-atom expressions to an object.

features.name: alter_state
features.summary: Changes per-atom coordinates and flags in a given state by evaluating an expression per atom.
features.signature: alter_state(state, selection, expression, quiet=1, space=None, atomic=1)

features.name: assign_stereo
features.summary: Assigns the R/S stereo atom property, requiring a Schrodinger Suite or RDKit backend.

features.name: attach
features.summary: Adds a single new atom onto the currently picked atom with a given geometry and valence.

features.name: bond
features.summary: Creates a new bond between two single-atom selections (default pk1/pk2), within the same object.

features.name: check
features.summary: Unsupported stub that would assign forcefield parameters to a selection.

features.name: cycle_valence
features.summary: Cycles the bond order (single/double/triple/aromatic) of the currently picked bond.

features.name: delete
features.summary: Removes whole objects and named selections (not individual atoms).

features.name: deprotect
features.summary: Clears the protected flag on atoms, reversing the protect command.

features.name: drag
features.summary: Activates mouse dragging of a selection's atom coordinates, using camera-like mouse controls.

features.name: dss
features.summary: Assigns secondary structure (helix/sheet/loop) from backbone geometry and hydrogen-bonding patterns.

features.name: edit
features.summary: Picks one or more atoms (or a bond) for editing, populating the (pk1..pk4) picked selections.
features.signature: edit(selection1='', selection2='none', selection3='none', selection4='none', pkresi=0, pkbond=1, quiet=1)

features.name: fab
features.summary: Builds a peptide object from a one-letter amino-acid sequence, optionally with a preset secondary structure.
features.signature: fab(input, name=None, mode='peptide', resi=1, chain='', segi='', state=-1, dir=1, hydro=-1, ss=0, async_=0, quiet=1)

features.name: fix_chemistry
features.summary: Best-effort repair of bond orders/valences/atoms around a modified site (unsupported upstream).

features.name: fnab
features.summary: Builds a nucleic-acid object from a one-letter sequence as DNA or RNA, in A or B form, optionally as a double helix.

features.name: fragment
features.summary: Retrieves a 3D structure from the built-in fragment library (currently mostly amino acids).

features.name: fuse
features.summary: Joins two objects into one by forming a bond, moving/merging a copy of the first into the second.

features.name: get_editor_scheme
features.summary: Returns the current builder/editor scheme mode as an integer code.

features.name: h_add
features.summary: Adds hydrogens onto a molecule based on current heavy-atom valences (fills all open valences).

features.name: h_fill
features.summary: Removes and replaces the hydrogens on the atom or bond picked for editing.

features.name: h_fix
features.summary: Repositions existing hydrogen atoms (unsupported/legacy); used to fix backbone/amide H geometry.

features.name: invert
features.summary: Inverts the stereochemistry at the picked atom, holding two attached atoms fixed.

features.name: load_coords
features.summary: API-only loader that writes an Nx3 coordinate array into a selection's atoms in atom-sorted order.

features.name: load_coordset
features.summary: API-only loader that writes an Nx3 coordinate array into an object in original file atom order, appending a state when state=0.

features.name: mask
features.summary: Makes atoms impossible to select with the mouse without affecting command-line selection or transforms.

features.name: mse2met
features.summary: Mutates selenomethionine (MSE) residues to methionine (MET).

features.name: protect
features.summary: Protects atoms from transformations performed by the editing features (torsion, drag, sculpt).

features.name: protonate
features.summary: Adds hydrogens with pH-dependent protonation states (PROPKA or textbook pKa), unlike h_add.

features.name: pseudoatom
features.summary: Adds a placeholder/marker pseudoatom to a molecular object, creating the object if needed.
features.signature: pseudoatom(object='', selection='', name='PS1', resn='PSD', resi='1', chain='P', segi='PSDO', elem='PS', vdw=-1.0, hetatm=1, b=0.0, q=0.0, color='', label='', pos=None, state=0, mode='rms', quiet=1)

features.name: push_undo
features.summary: Pushes the current object conformations onto their per-object undo rings.
features.signature: push_undo(selection, just_coordinates=1, finish_undo=0, add_objects=0, delete_objects=0, state=0)

features.name: rebond
features.summary: Discards all bonds in an object and recomputes them by interatomic distance.

features.name: redo
features.summary: Reapply the last undone conformational change to the object being edited.

features.name: reference
features.summary: Manage a per-atom reference state (validate/store/recall/swap) for a selection.

features.name: remove
features.summary: Eliminates the atoms in a selection from their molecular objects (keeps the object).

features.name: remove_picked
features.summary: Removes the atom or bond currently picked for editing, optionally with attached hydrogens.

features.name: rename
features.summary: Generates atom names that are unique within each residue of a selection.

features.name: replace
features.summary: Replaces the currently picked atom with a new atom of a given element, geometry, and valence.
features.signature: replace(element, geometry, valence, h_fill=1, name='', quiet=1)

features.name: rotate
features.summary: Rotates atom coordinates in a selection about an axis, or modifies an object/state matrix.
features.signature: rotate(axis='x', angle=0.0, selection='all', state=-1, camera=1, object=None, origin=None, object_mode=0)

features.name: set_dihedral
features.summary: Sets the dihedral angle defined by four bonded, acyclic atoms by rotating about the central bond.
features.signature: set_dihedral(atom1, atom2, atom3, atom4, angle, state=1, quiet=1)

features.name: set_geometry
features.summary: Changes PyMOL's assumed valence/geometry (hybridization) of atoms so H-filling and bonding behave.

features.name: smooth
features.summary: Applies a moving-window average across coordinate states to damp high-frequency motion in a trajectory.
features.signature: smooth(selection='all', passes=1, window=5, first=1, last=0, ends=0, quiet=1, cutoff=-1, pbc=1)

features.name: sort
features.summary: Reorders atoms within objects into canonical order, typically after alter has changed naming properties.

features.name: torsion
features.summary: Rotates the torsion about the currently picked bond by a delta angle.

features.name: transform_object
features.summary: API-only function that applies a 4x4 transformation matrix to an object (or its TTT matrix).
features.signature: transform_object(name, matrix, state=-1, log=0, selection='', homogenous=0, transpose=0)

features.name: transform_selection
features.summary: Applies a 4x4 transformation matrix to the atomic coordinates of a selection.
features.signature: transform_selection(selection, matrix, state=-1, log=0, homogenous=0, transpose=0)

features.name: translate
features.summary: Translates the atomic coordinates of a selection, or modifies an object's display/TTT matrix.
features.signature: translate(vector=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], selection='all', state=-1, camera=1, object=None, object_mode=0)

features.name: translate_atom
features.summary: Translates a single picked atom by a vector; the primitive behind interactive atom dragging.
features.signature: translate_atom(sele1, v0, v1, v2, state=0, mode=0, log=0)

features.name: unbond
features.summary: Removes all bonds between two atom selections.

features.name: undo
features.summary: Restores the previous conformation of the object currently being edited.

features.name: uniquify
features.summary: Renames an atom identifier so its values are unique relative to a reference selection.

features.name: unpick
features.summary: Deletes the pk1, pk2, ... editor selections used for atom picking and molecular editing.

features.name: update
features.summary: Transfers coordinates from a source selection onto a target selection.
features.signature: update(target, source, target_state=0, source_state=0, matchmaker=1, quiet=1)

features.name: valence
features.summary: Sets the bond order of all bonds between two selections (single/double/triple/aromatic/guess/copy).
features.signature: valence(order, selection1=None, selection2=None, source='', target_state=0, source_state=0, reset=1, quiet=1, symop='')

features.name: vdw_fit
features.summary: Unsupported/experimental feature that fits van der Waals radii between two selections.
features.signature: vdw_fit(selection1, selection2, state1=1, state2=1, buffer=0.24, quiet=1)

features.summary: The @file.pml directive that inline-includes and executes a PyMOL command script.

features.name: accept
features.summary: Internal handler that approves potentially unsafe content in a loading session file.

features.name: as_pathstr
features.summary: Internal helper that normalises a filesystem path to a platform-appropriate string.

features.name: download_chem_comp
features.summary: Internal routine that downloads the RCSB chemical-component CIF for a residue name and returns its local path.

features.name: fetch
features.summary: Download a structure, map or chemical component by accession code from PDB/PDBe/PDBj/EMDB/PubChem/CCD and load it.
features.signature: fetch(code, name='', state=0, finish=1, discrete=-1, multiplex=-2, zoom=-1, type='', async_=0, path='', file=None, quiet=1)

features.name: file_read
features.summary: Internal helper that reads a file (optionally gzip/bzip2 compressed) and returns its contents.

features.name: filename_to_objectname
features.summary: Internal helper that derives a legal PyMOL object name from a filesystem path.

features.name: finish_object

features.summary: Restore a session dictionary (or its zlib+pickle bytes) into the current instance, triggering the security wizard on embedded movie commands.

features.summary: Fits all states of an object onto a reference state and moves them; returns the per-state RMS array.

features.name: intra_rms
features.summary: Computes best-fit RMS for all states of an object relative to a reference state, leaving coordinates unchanged.

features.name: intra_rms_cur
features.summary: Computes RMS for all states of an object relative to a reference state with no fitting (state analogue of rms_cur).

features.name: matrix_copy
features.summary: Copies an object's transformation matrix onto another object (or into the camera view).

features.name: rms_cur

features.name: set_raw_alignment
features.summary: API-only command that builds an alignment object from explicit lists of (model, index) atom-pair columns.

features.name: contour_sc

features.name: get_modal_draw

features.name: ready

features.name: set_name
features.summary: Renames an object or a named selection.

features.name: split_chains
features.summary: Creates a single new object for each chain found in a selection.

features.name: ungroup
features.summary: Removes an object from a group, returning it to the top level.

features.name: pretty
features.summary: Applies a clean cartoon-plus-ligand-sticks display preset to a selection.

features.name: publication
features.summary: Applies a publication-quality cartoon display preset built on top of pretty.

features.name: simple
features.summary: Preset that draws structures as color-by-chain ribbons with lines/sticks for cysteines and ligands.

features.name: technical
features.summary: Applies the 'technical' visual preset — chainbow ribbon, colored ligands, non-bonded atoms and hydrogen-bond dashes.

features.name: get_property
features.summary: Read a single named object-level property from an object for a given state.

features.name: get_property_list
features.summary: Return all object-level properties of an object (for a given state) as a list.

features.name: alter
features.summary: Change atomic properties via a Python expression evaluated per atom; run sort afterward.

features.name: centerofmass
features.summary: Computes the mass- and occupancy-weighted center of mass of a selection.

features.name: count_atoms
features.summary: Returns the number of atoms matching a selection.

features.name: count_discrete
features.summary: Counts the number of discrete objects spanned by a selection.

features.name: find_pairs
features.summary: API-only function returning a list of (model,index) atom pairs within a distance cutoff, optionally restricted to hydrogen-bond-like geometry.
features.signature: find_pairs(selection1, selection2, state1=1, state2=1, cutoff=3.5, mode=0, angle=45)

features.name: get_angle
features.summary: Return the angle (degrees) between three atoms in a state.

features.name: get_area
features.summary: Compute molecular surface area of a selection (SES/SASA per dot_solvent), optionally into b-factors.

features.name: get_atom_coords
features.summary: Return the [x,y,z] coordinates of a single atom; errors on 0 or >1 matches.

features.name: get_bonds
features.summary: Returns a list of (atm1, atm2, order) tuples for bonds in the given state.

features.name: get_chains
features.summary: List the chain identifiers present in a selection (state currently ignored).

features.name: get_color_index
features.summary: Return the internal integer color index for a color name/spec.

features.name: get_color_tuple
features.summary: Return the (r,g,b) tuple in 0.0-1.0 for a color name/index.

features.name: get_coords
features.summary: Returns a selection's coordinates as a NumPy array (API-only).

features.name: get_coordset
features.summary: Returns an object's coordinate set for a state as a NumPy array (API-only).

features.name: get_distance
features.summary: Return the distance (Angstroms) between two atoms in a state, without creating an object.

features.name: get_drag_object_name
features.summary: Returns the name of the object currently in drag (mouse-move) mode.

features.name: get_names
features.summary: Return object and/or selection names by type (objects/selections/public/groups).

features.name: get_object_matrix
features.summary: Query the transformation matrix (object + optional TTT) associated with an object for a given state.

features.name: get_object_settings
features.summary: Query the per-object (and per-state) setting overrides stored on an object.

features.name: get_object_state
features.summary: Return the effective (currently displayed) state index for a single object.

features.name: get_object_ttt
features.summary: Query an object's TTT (transient transformation) matrix, optionally printing it.

features.name: get_phipsi
features.summary: Return backbone (phi,psi) angles per residue keyed by (object,index).

features.name: get_selection_state
features.summary: Return the single effective object state shared by all objects in a selection, or raise if they differ.

features.name: get_type
features.summary: Return a string describing a named object or selection (object:molecule, selection, ...).

features.name: get_version
features.summary: Return the PyMOL version tuple (text, float, int, build date, git sha, svn rev).

features.name: id_atom
features.summary: Returns the source ID of a single atom, raising if zero or multiple atoms match.

features.name: identify
features.summary: Return stable source atom IDs (optionally as (object,id) tuples) for a selection.

features.name: index
features.summary: Return fragile (object, 1-based index) tuples for atoms in a selection.

features.name: iterate
features.summary: Evaluate a read-only Python expression once per atom in a selection within a temporary namespace.

features.name: iterate_state
features.summary: Evaluate a read-only Python expression per atom for a specific coordinate state, exposing x/y/z.
features.signature: iterate_state(state, selection, expression, quiet=1, space=None, atomic=1)

features.name: phi_psi
features.summary: Return and optionally pretty-print phi/psi angles for a protein selection.

features.name: set_atom_property
features.summary: Set an atom-level custom property, reachable in iterate/alter via the p object.
features.signature: set_atom_property(name, value, selection='all', state=0, proptype=-1, quiet=1)

features.name: set_property
features.summary: Set an object-level custom property with typed or auto-detected value.
features.signature: set_property(name, value, object='*', state=0, proptype=-1, quiet=1)

features.name: cache
features.summary: Manages storage of precomputed results such as molecular surfaces.

features.name: capture
features.summary: Captures the current frame as an antialiased OpenGL image.

features.name: copy_image
features.summary: Copies the current rendered image to the system clipboard (incentive/proprietary, GUI-thread only).

features.name: draw
features.summary: Creates a fast OpenGL raster of the current frame (no shadows/ray effects); needs a live GL context.

features.name: dump
features.summary: Writes the raw geometry of an isosurface/isomesh/isodot or map object to a plain-text vertex file.

features.name: focal_blur
features.summary: Produces a depth-of-field image by averaging several jittered renders, keeping the object at the origin in focus.

features.name: get_collada
features.summary: Returns a COLLADA (.dae) string representing the currently displayed scene.

features.name: get_gltf
features.summary: Writes a glTF file by exporting COLLADA then converting it via an external collada2gltf binary.

features.name: get_idtf
features.summary: Returns an IDTF (U3D/3D-PDF) export of the scene; under development, prints 3D-PDF view params when not quiet.

features.name: get_image
features.summary: Returns the last rendered frame's raw RGBA framebuffer — the headless screen-capture accessor.

features.name: get_mtl_obj
features.summary: Returns a (mtl, obj) Wavefront tuple for Maya; incomplete — the .MTL half is not implemented.

features.name: get_povray
features.summary: Returns a (header, geometry) tuple forming a complete POV-Ray input file for the current scene.

features.name: get_renderer
features.summary: Return (and optionally print) the OpenGL vendor / renderer / version strings.

features.name: get_stlstr
features.summary: STL geometry export of surfaces/CGO (reached via save *.stl); raises IncentiveOnlyException in the open build.

features.name: get_vrml
features.summary: Returns a VRML2 (.wrl) string of the current display for import into other 3D tools.

features.name: ipython_image
features.summary: Renders the scene and returns it as an IPython.display.Image for inline notebook display.

features.name: load_png
features.summary: Load and display a PNG image from disk in the PyMOL viewport, optionally as a movie frame.

features.name: mpng
features.summary: Writes the movie as a series of numbered PNG frames, ray-traced or drawn per ray_trace_frames/draw_frames.
features.signature: mpng(prefix, first=0, last=0, preserve=0, modal=0, mode=-1, quiet=1, width=0, height=0)

features.name: png
features.summary: Saves the current display to a PNG file, optionally ray-tracing first and honouring width/height/dpi.
features.signature: png(filename, width=0, height=0, dpi=-1.0, ray=0, quiet=1, prior=0, format=0)

features.name: ray
features.summary: Produces a ray-traced image of the current frame with the built-in CPU renderer (shadows, outlines, interior colours, antialiasing).
features.signature: ray(width=0, height=0, antialias=-1, angle=0.0, shift=0.0, renderer=-1, quiet=1, async_=0)

features.name: write_html_ref
features.summary: Writes the full PyMOL command reference (every keyword + docstring) to a self-contained HTML file.

features.name: as
features.summary: Exclusive show: turns on one representation and hides all others for the selection.

features.name: cartoon
features.summary: Overrides the cartoon sub-type (loop, tube, arrow, putty, ...) for a selection.

features.name: cartoon (command)
features.summary: Overrides the per-residue cartoon cross-section (automatic/skip/loop/rectangle/oval/tube/arrow/dumbbell/putty).

features.name: get_vis
features.summary: Return an opaque snapshot of the current visibility state of all objects.

features.name: hide
features.summary: Turns off a representation for atoms/bonds in a selection.

features.name: rebuild
features.summary: Forces PyMOL to recreate rep geometry that has gone out of sync so it regenerates on next update.

features.name: refresh
features.summary: Requests a scene redraw as soon as the OS allows, without discarding geometry.

features.name: set_bond
features.summary: Sets a per-bond representation setting (stick_radius, valence, ...) on bonds between two selections.

features.name: set_vis
features.summary: Restores object/representation visibility state from a visibility dictionary (counterpart of get_vis).

features.name: show
features.summary: Turns on a representation for the atoms/objects in a selection (additive; leaves other representations intact).

features.name: show_as
features.summary: Exclusively shows one representation for a selection, hiding all others on those atoms (the 'as' command).

features.name: toggle
features.summary: Toggles the visibility of a representation within an atom selection.

features.name: clean
features.summary: Run MMFF94 energy minimization on a selection; raises IncentiveOnlyException upstream, ported as covalent idealisation.
features.signature: clean(selection, present='', state=-1, fix='', restrain='', method='mmff', async_=0, save_undo=1, message=None)

features.name: fast_minimize
features.summary: Unsupported, nonfunctional placeholder that may eventually perform a quick structure clean-up.

features.name: minimize
features.summary: Batch energy minimization; upstream stub routing to chempy.tinker, ported as covalent-radius idealisation.

features.name: sculpt_activate
features.summary: Enables sculpting for an object and snapshots its current geometry as the reference for restraints.

features.name: sculpt_deactivate
features.summary: Turns off sculpting for an object and discards its stored geometry restraints.

features.name: sculpt_iterate
features.summary: Runs N cycles of restraint-based energy minimization on a sculpt-activated object and returns the strain energy.

features.name: sculpt_purge
features.summary: Flushes all cached sculpt restraint sets globally (upstream: unsupported feature).

features.name: deselect
features.summary: Disables (hides) all currently visible named selections.

features.name: flag
features.summary: Sets or clears a named/numbered atom flag over a selection, controlling modeling roles like fixed, free, focus, and ignore.

features.name: indicate
features.summary: Shows a transient visual overlay marking the atoms of a selection.

features.name: pop
features.summary: Moves one atom at a time from a source selection into a named selection.

features.name: select
features.summary: Creates a named atom selection from a selection-expression.
features.signature: select(name, selection='', enable=-1, quiet=1, merge=0, state=0, domain='')

features.name: select_list
features.summary: API-only command that selects atoms of one object by an explicit list of IDs, indices, or ranks.
features.signature: select_list(name, object, id_list, state=0, mode='id', quiet=1)

features.name: unmask
features.summary: Reverses the effect of "mask" on the indicated atoms, re-enabling mouse picking.

features.name: get
features.summary: Prints and returns the current value of a global, per-object, or per-state setting.

features.name: get_bond
features.summary: Returns per-bond setting values for all bonds between two atom selections.
features.signature: get_bond(name, selection1, selection2=None, state=0, updates=1, quiet=1)

features.name: get_setting_boolean
features.summary: Read a single setting's value coerced to a Python boolean.

features.name: get_setting_float
features.summary: Read a single setting's value coerced to a Python float.

features.name: get_setting_int
features.summary: Read a single setting's value coerced to a Python int.

features.name: get_setting_legacy
features.summary: Legacy alias of get_setting_float that reads a setting as a float.

features.name: get_setting_text
features.summary: Read a single setting's value coerced to a text/string form.

features.name: get_setting_tuple
features.summary: Read a setting as a (type, value) tuple with legacy value packaging.

features.name: get_setting_updates
features.summary: Return the list of setting indices changed since the last poll.

features.name: help_setting
features.summary: Prints documentation for a named setting.

features.name: set
features.summary: Changes a global, per-object, per-object-state, or per-atom setting.
features.signature: set(name, value=1, selection='', state=0, updates=1, log=0, quiet=1)

features.name: unset
features.summary: Clears a setting and restores its default value (global or per-object/state/atom).
features.signature: unset(name, selection='', state=0, updates=1, log=0, quiet=1)

features.name: unset_bond
features.summary: Removes a per-bond setting for the bonds between two atom selections.
features.signature: unset_bond(name, selection1, selection2=None, state=0, updates=1, log=0, quiet=1)

features.name: unset_deep
features.summary: Unsets all object, object-state, atom, and bond level settings across objects.

features.name: get_assembly_ids
features.summary: Experimental: returns the list of biological-assembly ids from an mmCIF-loaded object.

features.name: get_symmetry
features.summary: Returns a molecule or map's crystal cell and space group as [a,b,c,alpha,beta,gamma,spacegroup].

features.name: pbc_unwrap
features.summary: Unwraps atoms or molecules so they stop jumping across periodic boundaries in a trajectory.

features.name: pbc_wrap
features.summary: Wraps molecules by whole lattice vectors back into the periodic (PBC) box.

features.name: set_symmetry
features.summary: Defines or redefines the crystal cell parameters and space group for a molecule or map object.
features.signature: set_symmetry(selection, a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma, spacegroup='P1', state=-1, quiet=1)

features.name: symexp
features.summary: Creates every space-group and lattice symmetry mate of an object that falls within a cutoff of an atom selection, as fresh prefix## objects.
features.signature: symexp(prefix, object, selection, cutoff, segi=0, quiet=1)

features.name: symmetry_copy
features.summary: Copies symmetry information (unit cell and space group) from one object to another.

features.name: button
features.summary: Redefines what a mouse button plus modifier does in the current mouse mode.

features.name: config_mouse
features.summary: Sets the active mouse configuration ring (three-button, two-button, one-button, maestro, motions, all-modes).

features.name: edit_mode
features.summary: Toggles the mouse between the viewing and editing variant of the current mode family.

features.name: editing_ring
features.summary: Clipboard-ring helper for copy/cut/paste/invert of molecular selections, backing CTRL-C/X/V/I.

features.name: mouse
features.summary: Cycles through or jumps to the mouse modes of the current configuration ring, or steps the selection level.

features.name: set_key
features.summary: Binds a Python function or command string to a redefinable key (F-keys, arrows, CTRL/ALT/CTSH letters).

features.name: splash
features.summary: Shows the PyMOL splash screen / startup information.

features.name: bg_color
features.summary: Set the scene background colour by name or number.

features.name: bg_colour
features.summary: British-spelling alias of bg_color; sets the viewport background color.

features.name: center
features.summary: Translate the window, clipping slab and origin to the centre of an atom selection.

features.name: clip
features.summary: Alter the near/far clipping-plane positions via near/far/move/slab/atoms modes.

features.name: full_screen
features.summary: Enable or disable full-screen mode (GUI-thread bound, platform dependent).

features.name: get_clip
features.summary: Returns the current positions of the near and far clipping planes.

features.name: get_position
features.summary: Return the 3D coordinates of the center of the viewer window (camera origin of rotation).

features.name: get_view
features.summary: Return (and optionally print) the current 18-float view vector for pasting into a script.

features.name: get_viewport
features.summary: Return (and optionally print) the screen viewport size as (width, height).

features.name: look_at
features.summary: Rotate an object (or the camera view) so its forward z-axis points at the center of a target object.

features.name: move
features.summary: Translate the camera along one of the three primary axes (a z move carries the clip planes).

features.name: orient
features.summary: Align the selection's principal components with the XYZ axes and frame it.

features.name: origin
features.summary: Set the centre of rotation about a selection, an explicit position, or an object.

features.name: reset
features.summary: Reset the rotation to identity, origin to centre of mass and zoom to all objects (or reset an object's matrix).

features.name: rock
features.summary: Toggle live camera rocking (idle-loop sweep/spin/nutate, honouring the sweep_* settings).

features.name: set_object_ttt
features.summary: API-only command that sets an object's TTT (view-transformation) matrix.

features.name: set_view
features.summary: Restores the full camera state (rotation, position, origin, clipping planes, orthoscopic flag) from an 18-float view sequence.

features.name: stereo
features.summary: Activate or deactivate stereo display and choose the stereo mode.

features.name: turn
features.summary: Rotates the camera about one of the three primary axes, centered at the origin.

features.name: view
features.summary: Store, recall or clear named camera views in a per-session dictionary (F1-F12 fallbacks).

features.name: viewport
features.summary: Change the size of the graphics display area (tuple syntax deprecated).

features.name: window
features.summary: Control visibility and geometry of PyMOL's output window (GUI-shell operation).

features.name: zoom
features.summary: Scale and translate the window and origin to cover an atom selection, guessing an optimal zoom level.

features.name: dirty_wizard
features.summary: Flag the wizard so the next render pass performs a deferred, feedback-safe refresh.

features.name: get_wizard
features.summary: Return the active (topmost) wizard instance, or None if no wizard is active.

features.name: get_wizard_stack
features.summary: Returns the internal stack of active wizard objects.

features.name: refresh_wizard
features.summary: Internal, unsupported command that redraws the active wizard's GUI prompt/menu.

features.name: replace_wizard
features.summary: Unsupported internal helper that launches (or clears) a wizard, replacing the current one.

features.name: set_wizard
features.summary: Internal command that installs a wizard instance as the active wizard, optionally replacing the current one.

features.name: set_wizard_stack
features.summary: Internal command that replaces the entire wizard stack with a supplied list.

features.name: wizard
features.summary: Launch a built-in wizard by name, pushing it onto the wizard stack.

features.name: auto-colour-cycle
features.summary: The auto/current special colours and 40-colour cycle (auto_color / auto_color_next) that give each new object or chain a fresh distinguishable colour.

features.name: builtin-spectrum-palettes
features.summary: The 57 named palettes spectrum accepts, each a (prefix, digits, first, last) slice of a generated 1000-colour band (o/s/r/c/w families).

features.name: colour-by-chain
features.summary: Assign a distinct colour per chain via util.cbc/color_chains, per object via color_objs, or an N-to-C rainbow per chain via chainbow.

features.name: colour-by-rep
features.summary: Colour a representation independently by writing per-rep colour settings (from rep_setting_lists) rather than atom colours.

features.name: colour-by-secondary-structure
features.summary: Colour atoms by secondary-structure type (helix/sheet/loop) via util.cbss or spectrum ss.

features.name: colour-index-integer-space
features.summary: The single flat integer namespace all colour references resolve into (named + generated bands + negative specials + ramp extensions + inline TRGB), and how set_color extends it without breaking frozen indices.

features.name: element-cpk-colouring
features.summary: Colour atoms by chemical element (CPK) via the 'atomic' special colour and the util.cb* / cnc helper family, typically keeping a chosen carbon colour.

features.name: spectrum-vs-spectrumany
features.summary: The two-tier spectrum dispatch: fast C-backed spectrum for named palettes on alphabetic expressions, pure-Python spectrumany fallback for colour lists, non-alpha expressions, and hls/hsv interpolation.

features.name: Builder panel
features.summary: The dockable GUI over the editing surface with Chemical/Protein/Nucleic Acid tabs and three action rows, every button issuing cmd.* calls.

features.name: join
features.summary: Not a PyMOL command; joining molecular objects is done with fuse (bond+merge) or create/combine.

features.name: sculpt controls
features.summary: The Builder's Sculpt/Clean/Fix/Rest group: real-time geometry relaxation with atom pinning and restraint flags.

features.name: session-format
features.summary: PyMOL's native .pse/.psw pickled-session format, including PNG thumbnail embedding and .psw presentation auto-start.

features.name: supported-formats
features.summary: The complete set of molecular, map, session, image and geometry formats PyMOL can read and/or write, dispatched by filename extension.

features.name: CCP4
features.summary: CCP4/MRC binary electron-density raster format loaded via cmd.load (format='ccp4'); also brix/dsn6/omap.

features.name: DX
features.summary: OpenDX/APBS electrostatics grid format (.dx/.dxbin) loaded via cmd.load (format='dx').

features.name: Volume Color Map Editor
features.summary: Interactive panel editing a volume's transfer function: map histogram plot with draggable color/alpha control points on a logarithmic alpha axis.

features.name: XPLOR
features.summary: XPLOR/CNS ASCII density map format loaded via cmd.load or the API-only read_xplorstr.

features.name: camera-framing
features.summary: The framing verbs zoom/center/orient/reset that reposition the camera over a selection.

features.name: movie-programs
features.summary: The pymol.movie add_* generators that program camera/state/scene loops in one call.

features.name: scene-fkeys
features.summary: F1-F12 recall/store scenes (falling back to views); PgUp/PgDn step scenes.

features.name: sequence-viewer
features.summary: In-viewport residue/atom grid (Seeker) whose cell clicks build the active selection.

features.name: set_state
features.summary: No dedicated command; set state via frame/set_frame or the per-object 'state' setting.

features.name: state-vs-frame
features.summary: Objects hold states (coordinate sets); the viewer has frames; mset maps frame->state, otherwise 1:1.

features.name: _prepare
features.summary: Internal helper every preset calls first: names the scratch selection, resets cartoons/reps, and unsets prior per-object settings.

features.name: get_sname_oname_dname
features.summary: Internal helper resolving a selection into scratch-name, object-name(s), and the polar-contacts distance-object name.

features.name: atom-namespace
features.summary: The per-atom symbol vocabulary (name, resn, resi, chain, b, q, elem, x/y/z, partial_charge, ...) exposed to iterate/alter.

features.name: cartoon arrow
features.summary: Rectangle slab with a C-terminal arrowhead - the beta-strand look (cartoon_fancy_sheets).

features.name: cartoon automatic
features.summary: Default cartoon mode picking cross-section per residue from secondary structure (HELIX/SHEET records).

features.name: cartoon dumbbell
features.summary: Flat ribbon edged with round rails (cartoon_dumbbell_length/width/radius).

features.name: cartoon loop
features.summary: Force a thin round tube (cartoon_loop_radius) for a selection, ignoring secondary structure.

features.name: cartoon oval
features.summary: Extrude an elliptical cross-section sized by cartoon_oval_length x cartoon_oval_width.

features.name: cartoon putty
features.summary: Variable-radius B-factor sausage tube mapping a per-atom property to thickness.

features.name: cartoon rectangle
features.summary: Extrude a flat rectangular slab (cartoon_rect_length x cartoon_rect_width) for a selection.

features.name: cartoon tube
features.summary: Force a fat round backbone tube (cartoon_tube_radius) with capped ends.

features.name: ramp
features.summary: Colour-ramp legend gadget that both documents and drives continuous colouring by map potential/proximity.

features.name: cSculptAngl
features.summary: 0x002 1-3 bond-angle harmonic restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptAvoid
features.summary: 0x800 avoidance restraint term (off in default mask).

features.name: cSculptBond
features.summary: 0x001 bond-length harmonic restraint term (on in default sculpt_field_mask).

features.name: cSculptLine
features.summary: 0x010 linearity restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptMax
features.summary: 0x400 maximum-distance restraint term (off in default mask).

features.name: cSculptMin
features.summary: 0x200 minimum-distance restraint term (off in default mask).

features.name: cSculptPlan
features.summary: 0x008 planarity restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptPyra
features.summary: 0x004 pyramidal (improper/chirality) restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptTors
features.summary: 0x080 torsion restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptTri
features.summary: 0x100 1-4 distance ('triangle') restraint term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptVDW
features.summary: 0x020 van-der-Waals clash repulsion term (on in default mask).

features.name: cSculptVDW14
features.summary: 0x040 1-4 van-der-Waals repulsion term (on in default mask).

features.name: space groups
features.summary: The table of Hermann-Mauguin space-group symmetry operators used to tile the unit cell; the TS port covers P1, P2, P2-1, P2-1-2-1-2-1 and C2 with a P1 identity fallback.

features.name: A action menu
features.summary: The per-row A (Action) toggle button opening a type-specific pymol.menu action menu (all_action/sele_action/mol_action/group_action/map_action/etc.).

features.name: Advanced Settings editor
features.summary: Modeless filterable table of every setting for reading and editing values by name.

features.name: ALT-attach bindings
features.summary: ALT-digit and ALT-letter defaults that grow fragments and attach amino acids onto pk1 from the keyboard.

features.name: Builder dialog
features.summary: Floating molecular-builder dock with Chemical/Protein/Nucleic tabs and always-visible editing action rows, arming action wizards on unpicked state.

features.name: busy-progress-box
features.summary: The in-viewport busy/progress box (OrthoBusyDraw): a top-left message box with up to two progress bars gated by show_progress.

features.name: butmode-block
features.summary: The ButMode mouse-mode indicator block: mode name line, optional key/button matrix, selection-mode line, frame-rate line, and click-to-cycle behaviour.

features.name: C color menu
features.summary: The per-row C (Color) rainbow toggle button opening mol_color (by element/chain/ss/rep/spectrum + full palette) or general/mesh/measurement/slice/vol/ramp color variants.

features.name: command-history
features.summary: The 255-entry command history ring with a slot-0 scratch buffer, dedup on submit, and Ctrl+Up prefix back-search.

features.name: command-line
features.summary: The CommandLineEdit input area (PyMOL> prompt) with Tab/Up/Down/Ctrl+Up/Enter key handling and live drag-and-drop text preview.

features.name: CTRL-letter bindings
features.summary: Default CTRL-A..Z shortcuts for select-all, clipboard ring, wizards, ligand zoom, bond, and undo/redo.

features.name: CTSH-letter editing bindings
